sf_sh.finding: Stormfront has an internal SH-numbered Shiny section.
sf_sh.scope: Source organization only; not a new printing-completeness assessment.

sv_sh.finding: Supreme Victors retains its own SH7–SH9 section.
sv_sh.scope: Source organization only; not a new printing-completeness assessment.
